Hi carter5922

During account setup wizard.

  1. Enter your email address
  2. Tap next button
  3. Tap the "configuration found" box
  4. Tap it's edit button.
  5. The incoming imap/pop server configuration is displayed. Tap next
  6. The outgoing SMTP server configuration is displayed.
  7. Apply your SMTP changes. Click next.

You can enter your settings at step 7.

To change an existing account's configuration. Navigate to ... settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server settings > account name > sending mail > outgoing server
